name: EHUB synthetic proposal ranking seed v1

snapshot.title: Smart student housing recommendation
snapshot.tagline: Find a room and compatible roommate near campus
snapshot.problem: University students struggle to find affordable verified rooms and compatible roommates near campus.
snapshot.solution: A student housing platform recommends rooms and roommate matches using budget, distance, lifestyle, and verified listings.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University students seeking rental accommodation near campus.
snapshot.valueProposition: Personalized room discovery, verified housing information, and roommate compatibility in one workflow.

snapshot.title: Campus room discovery platform
snapshot.tagline: Verified rentals for university communities
snapshot.problem: Students waste time comparing unreliable rental posts and cannot verify rooms close to their university.
snapshot.solution: A campus housing marketplace verifies landlords and filters rooms by price, location, utilities, and student preferences.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Students and landlords around universities.
snapshot.valueProposition: Trusted rental listings and faster room search for the student housing market.

snapshot.title: Roommate compatibility matching
snapshot.tagline: Live with people who fit your habits
snapshot.problem: Students often choose incompatible roommates because they lack structured lifestyle and budget information.
snapshot.solution: A roommate matching service compares study schedule, cleanliness, sleep habits, budget, and preferred campus area.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University students sharing apartments or dorm rooms.
snapshot.valueProposition: Reduce roommate conflict through transparent compatibility profiles and matching.

snapshot.title: Restaurant surplus food rescue
snapshot.tagline: Turn surplus meals into community support
snapshot.problem: Restaurants discard safe surplus food while nearby charities lack predictable meal donations.
snapshot.solution: A platform matches restaurant food surplus with verified charities and coordinates pickup before food expires.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Restaurants, food banks, charities, and volunteer delivery partners.
snapshot.valueProposition: Reduce food waste and make local meal donation traceable and reliable.

snapshot.title: Food donation coordination network
snapshot.tagline: Connect kitchens with people in need
snapshot.problem: Canteens and bakeries have unsold food but nonprofit organizations cannot discover donations quickly enough.
snapshot.solution: A donation network publishes available meals, verifies recipients, and assigns time-sensitive collection routes.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Food businesses and nonprofit meal programs.
snapshot.valueProposition: Fast discovery and accountable delivery of surplus food donations.

snapshot.title: Discount marketplace for unsold meals
snapshot.tagline: Affordable meals instead of food waste
snapshot.problem: Food stores lose money when fresh meals remain unsold at closing time.
snapshot.solution: Consumers reserve discounted surplus meal packages from nearby restaurants before closing.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Price-conscious consumers, restaurants, bakeries, and campus canteens.
snapshot.valueProposition: Recover restaurant revenue while reducing edible food waste.

snapshot.title: Mobile crop disease detection
snapshot.tagline: Detect plant disease from a field photo
snapshot.problem: Small farmers identify crop disease too late and lack immediate access to agricultural experts.
snapshot.solution: A mobile application analyzes leaf images, suggests likely crop diseases, and provides treatment guidance for farmers.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Smallholder farmers and agricultural extension workers.
snapshot.valueProposition: Earlier disease detection and accessible field guidance from a smartphone.

snapshot.title: Plant health computer vision assistant
snapshot.tagline: Photograph, diagnose, and protect crops
snapshot.problem: Farmers cannot reliably distinguish visual symptoms of pests, nutrient deficiencies, and plant diseases.
snapshot.solution: Computer vision classifies crop leaf symptoms and connects uncertain cases with agronomists.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Farmers, cooperatives, and crop advisors.
snapshot.valueProposition: Rapid visual screening with an expert escalation path.

snapshot.title: Community agricultural advisory service
snapshot.tagline: Practical farming advice on demand
snapshot.problem: Rural farmers wait days for advice when crops show unfamiliar disease symptoms.
snapshot.solution: Farmers submit field photos and questions to a network of verified agriculture specialists.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Rural farmers and independent agronomists.
snapshot.valueProposition: Timely expert advice for crop health decisions without traveling.

snapshot.title: Private university mental health support
snapshot.tagline: Reach the right support before a crisis
snapshot.problem: Students avoid mental health support because counseling access is confusing, slow, and perceived as stigmatizing.
snapshot.solution: A confidential platform provides wellbeing screening, counseling appointment booking, and guided support resources.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University students and campus counseling centers.
snapshot.valueProposition: A private and simple path from early concern to professional student support.

snapshot.title: Campus counseling appointment system
snapshot.tagline: Confidential counseling without administrative friction
snapshot.problem: Students cannot see counseling availability and abandon support when appointment coordination takes too long.
snapshot.solution: A secure booking system triages student needs and schedules sessions with appropriate campus counselors.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Students, university counselors, and student affairs offices.
snapshot.valueProposition: Shorter waiting time and confidential counseling coordination.

snapshot.title: Moderated peer wellbeing community
snapshot.tagline: Students supporting students safely
snapshot.problem: Students experiencing stress feel isolated but hesitate to contact formal mental health services.
snapshot.solution: A moderated peer support community offers anonymous discussion, wellbeing resources, and counselor referral.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University students seeking early emotional support.
snapshot.valueProposition: Low-pressure peer connection with safety moderation and professional escalation.

snapshot.title: Real-time campus shuttle tracking
snapshot.tagline: Know when the university bus will arrive
snapshot.problem: Students wait without reliable arrival information and miss classes when campus shuttle schedules change.
snapshot.solution: GPS tracking provides live shuttle location, predicted arrival time, route alerts, and occupancy information.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University students, staff, and campus transport operators.
snapshot.valueProposition: Reduce uncertain waiting and improve use of campus shuttle services.

snapshot.title: University bus arrival application
snapshot.tagline: Live routes for every campus stop
snapshot.problem: Fixed timetables do not reflect traffic delays, leaving students unsure when university buses arrive.
snapshot.solution: A mobile map streams bus GPS positions and sends arrival notifications for selected campus stops.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Students and university transportation departments.
snapshot.valueProposition: Accurate bus arrival visibility and fewer missed campus connections.

snapshot.title: Demand-aware university transport planning
snapshot.tagline: Plan shuttle capacity from student demand
snapshot.problem: Campus transport teams run empty buses on some routes while students crowd other stops.
snapshot.solution: Transport analytics predicts shuttle demand and recommends route frequency and capacity changes.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University operations teams and campus bus providers.
snapshot.valueProposition: Better shuttle route planning using observed student travel demand.

snapshot.title: Personal campus carbon footprint tracker
snapshot.tagline: Measure and reduce everyday emissions
snapshot.problem: Students want sustainable habits but cannot see the carbon impact of transport, food, and energy choices.
snapshot.solution: A carbon footprint application estimates daily emissions and recommends measurable low-carbon actions and challenges.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Students and universities running sustainability programs.
snapshot.valueProposition: Turn abstract climate goals into visible personal carbon reduction.

snapshot.title: University sustainability measurement dashboard
snapshot.tagline: Understand emissions across campus activity
snapshot.problem: Universities lack consistent data about commuting, energy use, and student participation in sustainability initiatives.
snapshot.solution: A dashboard aggregates campus carbon data and tracks progress against sustainability targets.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University sustainability offices and facilities teams.
snapshot.valueProposition: Evidence-based carbon planning and transparent campus sustainability reporting.

snapshot.title: Rewards for low-carbon student behavior
snapshot.tagline: Make sustainable choices worth repeating
snapshot.problem: Students understand climate issues but lack motivation to maintain low-carbon daily behavior.
snapshot.solution: A rewards platform verifies sustainable transport and recycling actions and grants campus benefits.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Students, universities, and sustainable campus merchants.
snapshot.valueProposition: Increase participation in carbon reduction through verified incentives.

snapshot.title: Ghép đôi gia sư đồng trang lứa cho môn học khó
snapshot.tagline: Tìm đúng sinh viên gia sư một cách nhanh chóng
snapshot.problem: Sinh viên gặp khó ở một số môn học chưa thể tìm được bạn học đáng tin cậy, có đúng kinh nghiệm môn học và lịch rảnh phù hợp.
snapshot.solution: Nền tảng gia sư ghép người học với sinh viên gia sư đã xác minh dựa trên môn học, kỹ năng, lịch học và cách học mong muốn.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Sinh viên đại học có nhu cầu học kèm hoặc cung cấp dịch vụ gia sư.
snapshot.valueProposition: Ghép đôi gia sư đúng môn học, đáng tin cậy ngay trong cộng đồng trường đại học.

snapshot.title: Sàn gia sư sinh viên theo từng môn học
snapshot.tagline: Kết nối học tập theo môn và lịch rảnh
snapshot.problem: Người học đang phụ thuộc vào bài đăng tự phát và khó đánh giá năng lực gia sư đối với một học phần cụ thể ở trường.
snapshot.solution: Sinh viên gia sư đã xác minh công khai lịch sử môn học, thời gian rảnh, hình thức học và phản hồi từ người học.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Sinh viên cần học kèm và sinh viên có thành tích tốt muốn làm gia sư.
snapshot.valueProposition: Lựa chọn gia sư minh bạch và đặt lịch gắn với các môn học thực tế của trường.

snapshot.title: Thành lập nhóm học tập nhỏ cùng tiến
snapshot.tagline: Tạo nhóm phù hợp cho từng môn học
snapshot.problem: Sinh viên khó tìm bạn cùng lớp có mục tiêu và thời gian học phù hợp cho những môn nhiều thử thách.
snapshot.solution: Dịch vụ ghép nhóm học tập dựa trên môn học, trình độ, mục tiêu và thời gian rảnh hằng tuần.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Sinh viên đại học đang theo học các môn có độ khó cao.
snapshot.valueProposition: Duy trì nhóm học cùng tiến ổn định mà không phải tìm kiếm trong các kênh trò chuyện tự phát.

snapshot.title: Digital ticketing for campus events
snapshot.tagline: Discover, reserve, and enter student events
snapshot.problem: Student clubs manage registration through disconnected forms and cannot prevent duplicate or fraudulent event tickets.
snapshot.solution: A campus event platform provides discovery, digital ticket reservation, QR check-in, and attendance reporting.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Student clubs, event organizers, and university students.
snapshot.valueProposition: One trusted workflow for campus event registration and admission.

snapshot.title: Student club event registration hub
snapshot.tagline: All campus activities in one calendar
snapshot.problem: Students miss activities while clubs manually combine registrations from multiple channels.
snapshot.solution: A university event directory supports registration, digital passes, reminders, and organizer attendance statistics.
snapshot.targetCustomers: University clubs, departments, and students.
snapshot.valueProposition: Central event discovery with reliable digital registration.

snapshot.title: Fast QR attendance for large events
snapshot.tagline: Verify every guest without entrance queues
snapshot.problem: Large student events create long queues and inaccurate attendance records with manual check-in.
snapshot.solution: Organizers issue unique QR tickets and scan them at multiple gates with duplicate detection.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Campus event organizers and conference teams.
snapshot.valueProposition: Faster admission and accurate event attendance evidence.

snapshot.title: Demand forecasting for small retailers
snapshot.tagline: Order the right stock before demand changes
snapshot.problem: Small shops overstock slow products and run out of popular items because purchasing relies on intuition.
snapshot.solution: An inventory system forecasts product demand from sales history, seasonality, promotions, and current stock.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Small retailers, convenience stores, and local shop owners.
snapshot.valueProposition: Reduce stockouts and waste through practical demand forecasting.

snapshot.title: Predictive replenishment for local stores
snapshot.tagline: Smart purchase suggestions for every shelf
snapshot.problem: Independent retailers lack analysts and order inventory too late or in excessive quantities.
snapshot.solution: Sales trends and seasonal signals generate product-level replenishment recommendations and low-stock alerts.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Independent stores and small retail chains.
snapshot.valueProposition: Accessible inventory forecasting without an enterprise planning system.

snapshot.title: Mobile stock control for micro businesses
snapshot.tagline: Simple inventory visibility from a phone
snapshot.problem: Micro retailers record stock manually and cannot identify missing, expired, or fast-moving products.
snapshot.solution: A mobile inventory application scans products, tracks quantities, and summarizes sales movement.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Micro businesses, kiosks, and family-owned stores.
snapshot.valueProposition: Low-cost stock control and clearer purchase decisions for small shops.

snapshot.title: Kết nối người hiến máu khẩn cấp
snapshot.tagline: Tiếp cận người hiến phù hợp ở gần khi thời gian là yếu tố quyết định
snapshot.problem: Bệnh viện và gia đình gặp khó khăn khi tìm người hiến máu tương thích, sẵn sàng trong các đợt thiếu máu khẩn cấp.
snapshot.solution: Mạng lưới người hiến đã xác minh ghép theo nhóm máu, vị trí, điều kiện hiến và thời gian sẵn sàng rồi gửi yêu cầu khẩn.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Bệnh viện, ngân hàng máu, bệnh nhân và người tình nguyện hiến máu.
snapshot.valueProposition: Tiếp cận người hiến đủ điều kiện ở gần nhanh hơn với cơ chế bảo mật và xác minh.

snapshot.title: Mạng lưới người hiến máu khẩn cấp đã xác minh
snapshot.tagline: Điều phối đúng người hiến máu trong thời gian ngắn
snapshot.problem: Yêu cầu hiến máu khẩn lan truyền trên mạng xã hội nhưng thiếu thông tin đáng tin cậy về điều kiện hiến và vị trí người hiến.
snapshot.solution: Bệnh viện công bố nhu cầu đã xác minh và thông báo đến người hiến tương thích theo nhóm máu, khoảng cách và lịch sử hiến.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Cơ sở y tế, ngân hàng máu và người hiến đã đăng ký.
snapshot.valueProposition: Điều phối yêu cầu máu đáng tin cậy và gửi thông báo đúng nhóm người hiến phù hợp.

snapshot.title: Quản lý chiến dịch hiến máu cộng đồng
snapshot.tagline: Lấp đầy lịch hẹn trước ngày tổ chức chiến dịch
snapshot.problem: Ngân hàng máu khó dự báo số người tham dự và vẫn phải điều phối thủ công người hiến trong các chiến dịch cộng đồng.
snapshot.solution: Nền tảng chiến dịch tuyển người đủ điều kiện, đặt khung giờ hiến, gửi nhắc lịch và báo cáo kết quả tiếp nhận máu.
snapshot.targetCustomers: Ngân hàng máu, bệnh viện, trường đại học và người tình nguyện hiến máu.
snapshot.valueProposition: Tăng độ tin cậy của số người tham gia và giúp sự kiện hiến máu vận hành trơn tru hơn.
